entities.summary: The Cambridge University Botanic Garden is a botanical garden located in Cambridge, England, associated with the university Department of Plant Sciences. It lies between Trumpington Road to the west, Bateman Street to the north and Hills Road to the east. Cambridge University Botanic Garden is a botanical garden in Europe, established in 1831.
